title: Why does women\x26#39;s pain last longer than men\x26#39;s? A new study offers an answer
titleZh: 不是矫情，科学证明男女疼痛机制不同
summary:
长期以来，研究慢性疼痛的科学家一直对一种特别的现象感到费解：遭遇车祸的一男一女，若伤势相同，其结果却常常大相径庭。女性往往长期受疼痛折磨，而男性则能较快康复。过去，部分医生将这种差异简单归因于女性夸大痛感，或认为她们对不适的耐受程度低于男性。然而，多项研究反复证实，女性在总体上更容易患上慢性疼痛，且疼痛持续时间平均也更长。

来源：NBC News；作者：Aria Bendix；原文发布时间：2026-02-22 20:00:00

paragraphs.contentEn: Scientists who study chronic pain have long puzzled over a particular type of scenario: A man and woman get into a car accident and sustain the same injuries. But the woman experiences long-lasting pain, while the man recovers more quickly. Historically, some doctors have dismissed these differences as women exaggerating their pain or being unable to tolerate the same discomfort as men. But studies have repeatedly found that women are more likely to experience chronic pain in general and that their pain lasts longer, on average.
paragraphs.contentZh: 长期以来，研究慢性疼痛的科学家一直对一种特别的现象感到费解：遭遇车祸的一男一女，若伤势相同，其结果却常常大相径庭。女性往往长期受疼痛折磨，而男性则能较快康复。过去，部分医生将这种差异简单归因于女性夸大痛感，或认为她们对不适的耐受程度低于男性。然而，多项研究反复证实，女性在总体上更容易患上慢性疼痛，且疼痛持续时间平均也更长。

paragraphs.contentEn: A study published Friday in the journal Science Immunology offers a clue as to why: Men’s immune systems may have a better mechanism for shutting off pain, likely because of their higher testosterone levels. “What we show is, it’s a real biological mechanism from the immune cells. It’s not in the mind,” said Geoffroy Laumet, one of the study’s authors and an associate professor of physiology at Michigan State University.
paragraphs.contentZh: 周五发表在《科学·免疫学》上的一项研究揭示了其中原委：男性免疫系统在抑制痛觉方面可能具备更高效的机制，这很可能与他们体内较高的睾酮水平有关。该研究作者之一、密歇根州立大学生理学副教授杰弗里·洛梅特表示：“我们的研究证实，这种差异源于免疫细胞中真实的生物机制，而非心理作用。”

paragraphs.contentEn: Ann Gregus, an assistant professor at Virginia Tech who researches ways to treat chronic pain, said the findings underscore the need to take women’s pain seriously. “A lot of women are taught to hide their pain, because then, if they don’t, people will perceive that they can’t do their jobs, that they can’t take care of their families,” Gregus, who wasn’t part of the new study, said.
paragraphs.contentZh: 长期研究慢性疼痛治疗方法的弗吉尼亚理工大学助理教授安·格雷格斯表示，这项发现凸显了认真对待女性疼痛的必要性。格雷格斯并未参与这项新研究，她说：“许多女性从小就被教导要隐忍疼痛，因为一旦表达出来，就可能被视作无法胜任工作，或照料不好家庭。”

paragraphs.contentEn: The findings apply to persistent pain after surgery or a physical trauma. However, other chronic pain conditions — like fibromyalgia — don’t follow a traumatic event. “Does it explain everything? I don’t think so. We don’t have any single, magical pathway,” said Dr. Michele Curatolo, a professor of anesthesiology and pain medicine at the University of Washington, who wasn’t involved in the new research. Curatolo is the chief medical officer at 4E Therapeutics, a neuroscience company developing treatments for pain.
paragraphs.contentZh: 这项研究发现主要适用于手术或身体创伤后出现的持续性疼痛。而其他类型的慢性疼痛——例如纤维肌痛——并非继发于创伤事件。未参与这项新研究的华盛顿大学麻醉学与疼痛医学教授米歇尔·库拉托洛表示：“这项发现能解释所有类型的疼痛吗？我并不这么认为。人体内并不存在某条单一、万能的通路。”库拉托洛目前还兼任神经科学公司4E Therapeutics的首席医疗官，该公司致力于开发疼痛治疗方案。

paragraphs.contentEn: For the new study, the researchers asked 245 people who had experienced traumatic injuries — primarily car accidents — to rate their level of pain. Though men and women had roughly the same pain severity on the day the injury occurred, men saw their pain resolve more quickly over a period of nearly three months. Blood tests showed that the men had higher levels of a molecule called interleukin-10, which switches off pain signals to the brain. Laumet said testosterone increased the production of interleukin-10 from white blood cells.
paragraphs.contentZh: 在这项新研究中，研究人员让245名曾遭受创伤性损伤的患者——其中大多因车祸受伤——对自身的疼痛程度进行评估。结果显示，在受伤当天，男女报告的疼痛强度大致相当，但在随后近三个月的时间里，男性的疼痛缓解速度更快。血液检测还发现，男性体内一种名为白细胞介素-10（interleukin-10）的分子水平更高，这种分子能够阻断向大脑传递的疼痛信号。洛梅特指出，睾酮会促进白细胞分泌更多的白细胞介素-10。

paragraphs.contentEn: The same was true in lab experiments involving mice. The team of scientists gave mice injections to stimulate an inflammatory response, and afterward, male mice showed signs of their pain resolving, whereas female mice did not. Male mice also recovered faster from a small surgical incision and from being restrained in a tube for two hours — a scenario designed to mimic the physical and emotional stress of a car accident. Across the experiments in mice, white blood cells that produce interleukin-10 were far more active in males.
paragraphs.contentZh: 在针对小鼠的实验室研究中，也观察到了相似的结果。研究团队通过注射诱发小鼠的炎症反应，随后，雄性小鼠出现疼痛逐渐缓解的迹象，而雌性小鼠则没有。此外，无论是遭受微小手术创口，还是被置于管道中限制活动两小时（这一设置旨在模拟车祸带来的身体和情绪压力），雄性小鼠的恢复速度都更快。在所有小鼠实验中，产生白细胞介素-10的白细胞在雄性体内的活性明显更高。

paragraphs.contentEn: Gregus said the new research likely reflects evolutionary differences between men and women. “It’s building upon a series of studies that have been done to show that men tend to use their innate immune system more effectively than women,” she said. (The innate immune system is the body’s first line of defense against foreign invaders.) But Curatolo added that the sex differences aren’t black and white — and men often have long-lasting pain, too.
paragraphs.contentZh: 格雷格斯表示，这项新研究很可能反映了男女在进化层面的差异。她说：“先前的许多研究表明，男性通常比女性能更高效地调动先天免疫系统，而本次发现是对这些成果的进一步拓展。”（先天免疫系统是人体抵御外源入侵的第一道防线。）不过，库拉托洛补充说，性别差异并非泾渭分明——男性同样也可能遭受慢性疼痛的困扰。

paragraphs.contentEn: In the long run, Laumet said, the findings could be used to develop new treatments for chronic pain in women, such as testosterone patches. Topical treatments like that tend to come with fewer side effects than systemic drugs, he said. As it stands, many of the current options for chronic pain relief have concerning side effects and don’t fully alleviate symptoms. Long-term use of over-the-counter painkillers can lead to kidney damage or stomach ulcers. Opioids, often prescribed as a last resort, can be addictive. Doctors even sometimes prescribe antidepressants or anti-seizure medications off-label for pain, but many patients with chronic pain don’t respond to them. And physical therapy or acupuncture may work for some patients but not others. “We clearly need alternative options,” Gregus said.
paragraphs.contentZh: 洛梅特表示，从长远看，这项发现或可用于开发针对女性慢性疼痛的新疗法，例如睾酮贴片。他指出，与全身性用药相比，这类局部外用治疗通常副作用更少。目前，许多慢性疼痛的治疗选择不仅难以完全缓解症状，还可能伴随显著的副作用。长期使用非处方止痛药可能损伤肾脏或引发胃溃疡。通常作为最后手段的阿片类药物则存在成瘾风险。医生有时会超说明书使用抗抑郁药或抗癫痫药来治疗疼痛，但不少慢性疼痛患者对这些药物反应不佳。物理治疗或针灸对部分患者有效，对另一些人则未必如此。格雷格斯认为：“我们显然需要更多替代选择。”
